BL-1665 — 125 of the 408 shell tests under swarmforge/scripts/test set pipefail and pipe multi-line output into grep -q (732 sites), so any assertion whose needle sits on an early line fails under load when the producer dies of SIGPIPE - test_merge_deletion_guard.sh case 02 on 2026-09-20, BL-1660's race in the test lane: every such pipe consumes its whole input, and a guard in the commit chain refuses a new one
What it solves: ## What is wrong
Approval context: A new feature file and a new commit-chain guard are authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. FIRM: the guard judges only files under swarmforge/scripts/test that set pipefail, and only a pipe whose consumer is grep with -q (any flag cluster containing q)…
BL-1665 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1665" (or "reject BL-1665 <reason>") to act.
